🥚 Shop: New Premium Egg!
A brand-new Premium Egg has arrived in the Shop, featuring 5 new pets to hatch and collect!

🎁 New Season & Loyalty Rewards!
A brand-new Season has begun with 1 exclusive new pet! Introducing the 3-Season Loyalty Track — reach Level 60 for 3 consecutive seasons to unlock an exclusive reward!

🎃 Halloween Event Returns!
The classic Halloween Weather and Halloween Event Egg are back! Obtain the Halloween Skybox twice to upgrade it to Level 2, boosting the Income of all Halloween Pets by 60%!

🔄 Exchange Area: New Pet!
A brand-new pet has been added to the Exchange Area! Trade your way to this exclusive new companion!

🧸 Big Pet & Big Fish Updates!
The level caps for both Big Pet and Big Fish have been increased by 10 levels! Plus, a brand-new Skin Fruit has arrived to give your Big Fish a fresh new look!
